description: Estonia's Health Board, Terviseamet, publishes the national surveillance statistics on notified communicable diseases. The statistics page brings together monthly summaries of cases by county, available as PDF for each month up to August 2026, annual overviews of communicable diseases and immunisation, a statistics series in 18 parts and historical tables by month and county going back to 2000 in Excel. Sub-pages cover respiratory viruses including influenza and COVID-19, HIV, tick-borne diseases and vaccination coverage. Coverage is national with county detail. The files are free and available to download from the Terviseamet site, with an English page for the bulletins; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: the monthly summaries are PDF tables of notified cases, which undercount true incidence, and formats change between periods. Simulation uses: estimating the seasonal and epidemic load placed on hospitals and primary care, calibrating epidemic models used in health system stress tests, and linking outbreaks to disruptions of water or food services. Related records: the Estonian health statistics database (data-tai-estonia-health-statistics-database) gives the capacity side, and the WHO health infrastructure indicators (data-who-gho-health-infrastructure-indicators) give international context.
